name: Lego Shoes
note: Moulded plastic blocks in primary colours, stacked into a strapped high heel.

name: Robot Leggings
note: Articulated gold-plated metal leggings: hinged plates down the front of each leg, black jersey behind. A handful were made.

name: Motorcycle City Bag
note: Slouching black lambskin with brass studs and tassels, carried from the shoulder. Not a cut garment: it is built in dist/archive-accessories.js and worn in the bag's place.

name: Arena Leather Jacket
note: The motorcycle jacket in the bag line's distressed lambskin, with its brass hardware.

name: Triple S Sneakers
note: Three soles stacked under a dad shoe, sold pre-dirtied.

name: Speed Trainers
note: A knitted sock on a white runner's sole.

name: Track Sneakers
note: A hiking shoe's cage of overlays on a layered sole.

name: Defender Sneakers
note: A trainer set in a tractor tyre.

name: Steroid Boots
note: A moulded foam boot inflated to three sizes too big.

name: Cargo Sneakers
note: A bulbous runner with a cargo pocket on its side, sold worn.

name: Teddy Jacket
note: The varsity jacket: black wool body, white leather sleeves and trim.

name: Distressed D02 Jeans
note: Skinny black denim, blown out at both knees.

name: Santiag Boots
note: Western boots on a slanted stacked heel.

name: Shark-Print Sweatshirt
note: A great white's open jaws across the chest.

name: Birds of Paradise Sweatshirt
note: A band of bird-of-paradise flowers round the chest and arms.

name: Madonna-Print Sweatshirt
note: A haloed figure in blue after a devotional painting, drawn fresh.

name: Star-Collar Sweatshirt
note: Stars ring the neckline; a red band with a star on each arm.
